decision.summary: Meadow Works say they fixed the shower mixer, but their attachments did not arrive. I told the landlord the amount isn't known yet, asked the contractor to resend, asked the tenant to confirm the fix, and set a follow-up for 3 June.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: The provider reports the work was done on 1 June. Invoice and photos are unseen, tenant confirmation is missing, and the landlord has not been told the amount.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Emails sent to the landlord (status), Meadow Works (resend invoice and photos) and the tenant (confirm fix); follow-up set for 3 June.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. This is routine chasing; escalate only if the invoice is above the approval or otherwise flagged.

args.body: Hi Kendall, yes. Meadow Works emailed today to say they attended the shower at Willowmere Road, found a problem with the mixer, cleaned and greased it, and say hot and cold are both running again. They said photos and an invoice were attached, but the attachments have not come through to us, so I can't tell you the amount yet. I've asked them to resend it, and I'm asking the tenant to confirm the shower works. I'll send you the invoice figure once I have it, and will update you by 4 June at the latest. Please don't pay anything until you hear from us.
